layers.cadence: provider-updated; checked no more than every 2 minutes

layers.source: NASA EONET, NASA LHASA; Landslide4Sense benchmark
layers.cadence: EONET polling every 10 minutes; LHASA product timing independent
layers.measures: reported events; separate NASA hazard outlook; post-event scar segmentation
layers.analysis: susceptibility and rainfall-trigger outlook are not the same as detected scars
layers.classification: post-event scar model is not calibrated hazard probability

layers.source: NASA ITS_LIVE and ESA Sentinel-1 published study
layers.cadence: static observations dated through 2024; no live updates
layers.measures: annual glacier speed and per-acquisition modelled lake area
layers.analysis: historical change; no water-level or breach probability

layers.cadence: EONET reports not equivalent to FIRMS latency
layers.measures: reported event; VIIRS detections require separate integration
layers.analysis: fuel/dryness and wind-sector logic planned, not validated
layers.classification: no wildfire risk score currently validated

layers.source: NASA EONET, NASA GIBS; Sentinel-1 and GloFAS planned
layers.measures: reported floods and dated satellite scenes
layers.classification: GloFAS not integrated as a validated forecast yet

exposure.potential: OSM buildings, roads, rail, bridges, power, dams plus population grids
exposure.status: on-demand spatially scoped research assessment; incompleteness must be surfaced
exposure.priority: hazard class + verified exposure + separate trigger evidence; not official alerts

thresholds: src/priority-core.js (transparent research triage; validate regionally before any safety use)
notes: Remove landslide catalogue from public layer list, not from scientific training archives
Historical velocities are not animated movement
Provider timestamps are not guaranteed detection latency
